decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The crown thinning works hereby approved shall not exceed removal of 20% of material from the crown which shall be removed systematically from throughout the tree rather than from the inner crown only, in order to achieve an even density of foliage retained throughout a well-spaced and balanced branch structure, in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved trees.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
